On the right, a building frontage with parked cars suggests some destination activity, but limited visible sidewalk activation (shops/entrances/people) weakens perceived everyday vitality.
The strong greenery presence improves pleasantness, yet the fenced median and wide roadway can create a psychological barrier between sides, reducing social connectivity.

aesthetics: Mature, continuous tree canopy along both sides creates strong visual enclosure and a high-quality boulevard character.

comfort: Large street trees provide substantial shade potential, supporting thermal comfort for anyone walking or waiting along the corridor edge.
